headline: Your Universal Accounting waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing accounting, bookkeeping, and tax professionals into the right Build-Your-Firm, Start-Your-Practice, Better-Job, or soft Success Journey offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Roger Knecht.
productSummary: Universal Accounting Center (universalaccounting.com) is a post-secondary education and coaching business — not a SaaS product — serving accounting, bookkeeping, and tax professionals since 1979. Homepage framing: training, certifications, coaching & support so professionals have the confidence and competence to excel and get paid what they are worth. Three Success Journey paths on-site: Better Job (Accountant Certification programs in as little as four weeks), Start Your Business (turnkey programs + coaching — in business for yourself but not by yourself), Build Your Business (retain clients, add value-based services, work efficiently and profitably). Core programs on /programs/: Color Accounting™, Professional Bookkeeper™, QuickBooks™ Specialist, Professional Tax Preparer™, Virtual Bookkeeper's Roadmap™, Profit & Growth Expert™, Advanced Coaching Program (monthly closed-group calls with Roger Knecht on marketing, accounting, production). Profit & Growth Expert page: 169+ video lessons, two manuals, 40 clock hours, 600+ pages of instruction, orientation + academic + marketing coaches; modules include In the BLACK, Red to BLACK, Strategic Selling, Universal Practice Builder, Profit First (Mike Michalowicz via Roger Knecht), Value Builder (John Warrillow via Roger Knecht). Public proof language: helping thousands of individuals (about-us); Allen Bostrom trained tens of thousands of accountants, bookkeepers, and tax preparers (PGE instructors). Free Accountrepreneurs Challenge (90-day give-back). GrowCon for owners of bookkeeping, accounting, and tax businesses. Roger Knecht = President and CEO. Prospect replied Sure, why not to Vivian's 5-page doc ask.
coreInsight: Roger sells one education + coaching ladder mapped to career stage — Better Job, Start Your Business, Build Your Business — not a different product per specialty. Bookkeeping vs tax vs payroll is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is practice_stage from LinkedIn Sales Nav / Apollo title + headline + company type: firm owner/principal, independent solo practitioner, employed staff professional, or none of those. That ladder maps to Universal's live offers (Profit & Growth Expert + Advanced Coaching, Virtual Bookkeeper Roadmap + start-up certs, Better-Job certifications, soft Success Journey / Accountrepreneurs Challenge for remaining TAM) and keeps one durable list for US accounting-profession outbound.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is where they sit in the practice ladder
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn Sales Nav / Apollo already names firm owners, independent practitioners, employed staff accountants/bookkeepers/tax pros, or none of those. That practice_stage is stronger than a specialty guess and cheap to collect in one pull.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM accounting professional
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Firm owner/principal first, then independent solo practitioner, then employed staff seeking a better job, then every remaining in-TAM accounting-interested lead.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each practice stage gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Owners get a Premier Firm Growth Brief (PGE + Advanced Coaching). Independents get a Practice Launch Roadmap. Employed pros get a Better-Job Certification Brief. The rest get the soft Success Journey / Accountrepreneurs Challenge.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Grow the firm, launch the practice, certify the W-2, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always US accounting, bookkeeping, and tax professionals Universal already sells into. Specialty (bookkeeping vs tax vs payroll) is a merge tag. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (profit-advisory vs client-acquisition).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the practice stage already on their LinkedIn
sections.takeaway: Notice the owner title, solo practice, or staff role, poke the growth / client-acquisition / career-ceiling pain that stage implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the firm-owner route first
sections.takeaway: Start where owners already feel client-retention and advisory-pricing pressure and Universal's Build Your Business / PGE / GrowCon path is the closest fit. Prove reply density, then roll independent launch, Better-Job certs, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav filtered to Universal's commercial TAM (US bookkeepers, accountants, tax preparers, payroll specialists, aspiring practice owners) is the spine Roger already sells into. Public TAM account count is not published on universalaccounting.com; treat size as estimated (see universal-accounting-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier ≥~1,500 contacts where possible.

LinkedIn title + headline + company type returns practice_stage in one pull: Owner / Founder / Principal / Managing Partner / Firm Owner of a bookkeeping, accounting, or tax practice for Tier 1; Independent / Self-employed / Freelance / Solo bookkeeper, EA, tax preparer for Tier 2; Staff Accountant / Bookkeeper / Tax Preparer / Payroll Specialist (W-2 employer) for Tier 3 — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live Universal offers on universalaccounting.com: Profit & Growth Expert + Advanced Coaching + GrowCon for firm owners; Virtual Bookkeeper's Roadmap + start-up certs + coaching for independents; Professional Bookkeeper / Tax Preparer / QuickBooks Specialist for Better-Job W-2 pros; soft Success Journey + free Accountrepreneurs Challenge for remaining TAM — plus since-1979 tenure and tens-of-thousands trained as proof language.
Specialty (bookkeeping vs tax vs payroll) and city are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND firm_owner_detected = true (LinkedIn title/headline names Owner, Founder, Principal, Managing Partner, President, or Firm Owner of a bookkeeping, accounting, tax, or payroll practice) AND not already_student
routingRules.why: They already run a practice and feel the ceiling on compliance-only work. Strongest intent for Universal's Build Your Business path — Profit & Growth Expert (169+ lessons, Profit First + Value Builder modules), Advanced Coaching with Roger Knecht, and GrowCon community. Pain inferred from trigger: owners stuck in production instead of advisory/marketing.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND independent_practice_detected = true (Self-employed, Independent, Freelance, Solo bookkeeper / tax preparer / EA / accountant; company type = self-employed) AND no Tier-1 firm-owner match AND not already_student
routingRules.why: They hung out a shingle but still need turnkey workflow, pricing, and client acquisition. Maps to Virtual Bookkeeper's Roadmap + Professional Bookkeeper / Tax Preparer certs + marketing coaching — Start Your Business path on the homepage.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND employed_staff_detected = true (Staff Accountant, Bookkeeper, Tax Preparer, Payroll Specialist, Accounting Clerk at an employer; W-2 framing) AND no Tier 1–2 practice match AND not already_student
routingRules.why: They want competence credentials and a pay bump without years of school. Maps to Professional Bookkeeper™, Professional Tax Preparer™, QuickBooks™ Specialist, Color Accounting™ — Better Job path (as little as four weeks / 3–6 weeks on homepage).

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (career changers, aspiring accountants, adjacent finance roles considering bookkeeping/tax). Soft CTA around free Accountrepreneurs Challenge (90-day) and Success Journey overview. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Firm owner / principal detected
tiers.trigger: LinkedIn title or headline names Owner, Founder, Principal, Managing Partner, President, or Firm Owner of a bookkeeping, accounting, tax, or payroll practice; not already a Universal student
tiers.pain: They already own the firm and still trade hours for compliance work — client retention, advisory pricing, and marketing sit behind the next busy season.
tiers.valueProp: Premier Firm Growth Brief: Profit & Growth Expert (169+ videos, Profit First + Value Builder with Roger Knecht) + Advanced Coaching monthly calls + GrowCon peer network. Anchored to since-1979 tenure and tens-of-thousands trained.
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn Sales Nav / Apollo title + headline for firm-owner language
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already own a practice and feel the growth ceiling
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on universalaccounting.com — keep each tier ≥~1,500 contacts before launch when the niche allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Independent solo practitioner
tiers.trigger: In-TAM contact shows Self-employed / Independent / Freelance / Solo bookkeeper, tax preparer, EA, or accountant with no Tier-1 firm-owner match
tiers.pain: The shingle is up, but workflow, pricing, and a predictable client pipeline are still improvised — feast-or-famine months and no coaching bench.
tiers.valueProp: Practice Launch Roadmap: Virtual Bookkeeper's Roadmap™ + Professional Bookkeeper / Tax Preparer certs + marketing coach — homepage Start Your Business promise (in business for yourself but not by yourself).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn / Apollo self-employed + solo-practice titles after firm-owner filter fails
tiers.replyDensity: High - visible start-up friction, clear turnkey path

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Employed staff accountant / bookkeeper / tax pro
tiers.trigger: In-TAM contact holds Staff Accountant, Bookkeeper, Tax Preparer, Payroll Specialist, or similar W-2 role with no Tier 1–2 practice match
tiers.pain: Career growth and pay are capped by missing credentials — peers certify and either get promoted or leave for better roles while they stay stuck in the same seat.
tiers.valueProp: Better-Job Certification Brief: Professional Bookkeeper™, Professional Tax Preparer™, QuickBooks™ Specialist, or Color Accounting™ — homepage Better Job path (as little as four weeks / 3–6 weeks, coaches after graduation).
tiers.dataSource: LinkedIn / Apollo employed staff titles after Tier 1–2 filters fail
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear credential motive, longer consideration cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM accounting-interested leads
tiers.trigger: In-TAM contact in US accounting / bookkeeping / tax / payroll / finance-adjacent roles or career-change intent with no Tier 1–3 practice_stage
tiers.pain: They are curious about accounting careers or side practices but have no clear next step — university paths feel too long and generic for small-business client work.
tiers.valueProp: Soft Success Journey overview + free Accountrepreneurs Challenge (90-day give-back on homepage) — since 1979, coaches included, soft CTA.
tiers.dataSource: Apollo / Sales Nav after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM
